perspective:
Angela’s available information:

- She is Angela Hwang, a hairdresser; Kevin Flores is her close friend since high school. They confide in each other.
- At coffee, she invited Kevin and heard him say he had been “alright, just the usual grind.” She told him she was worried because he seemed unhappy with his job. Kevin told her he was not happy, felt stuck and unfulfilled, and was just going through the motions.
- Angela suggested a different job or career path. Kevin said he had thought about it but did not know where to start and felt overwhelmed. Angela offered to figure it out together; Kevin agreed and thanked her.
- Angela found job openings and a career counseling service and told Kevin. Kevin thanked her and said he had been thinking a lot; he was interested in something more creative, maybe design or architecture. Angela encouraged him to check the resources; he said he would.
- Angela believed Kevin was hesitant and felt frustrated and worried. She arranged a meeting with a career coach and told him. Kevin said she did not have to, appreciated it, but was not sure he was ready. Angela encouraged him; he agreed to give it a shot and thanked her.
- Angela checked in about the career coach. Kevin told her the coach was helpful, he had started online courses in design, and he felt more confident about the change. Angela felt proud and relieved and offered more help. Kevin said her support was enough and he would tell her if he needed anything.
- Angela believed Kevin had successfully transitioned to a new career. She felt happy and satisfied and organized a small celebration party for his new career. Kevin thanked her, said he was grateful, and said he could not have done it without her. Angela told him he did the hard work, and they celebrated.

Angela does not have access to anything Kevin did not tell her or show her directly.
